Diggerz Custom Wearable Maker

Built from the exact Diggerz player rig. Animations play in the preview so you can see how wearables move on the real Diggerz body. There is no animation editor — choose any default animation and preview it live.
Default Diggerz animations play live. Pause to inspect an exact frame, or restart the animation from the beginning.

Visual transform

Select a layer, then drag the image to move it. Drag the corner handles to resize and the round handle to rotate. Use the flip buttons for facing direction.

Item layers

Upload transparent PNGs for the parts your item needs. Presets use Diggerz's real wearable attachment points: head, torso, pants, feet, hands/arms and holdable anchor.
Rig source: Diggerz Player Rig Editor. Native rig dimensions: 56.05 × 90.86; head attachment is 56 × 50.
